description: Read or write to the system clipboard.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

dataUrl.description: Base64 data URL of an image to write to clipboard (e.g. 'data:image/png;base64,...').

mimeType.description: MIME type override for image write (auto-detected from dataUrl by default, e.g. 'image/png').

text.description: Text to write to clipboard (for write action).

name: browser_clipboard
